notes: Main prizes (1st–4th) go to the house whose last remaining team reaches each stage.
Side prizes: most goals conceded, fair play award.

side_prize_tie_break.prize: Most goals team tie rule order
side_prize_tie_break.order:
Most goals conceded
If tied, most matches played loses (because they conceded the same number across more games)
If still tied, worst goal difference
If still tied, fewest goals scored
If still tied, earliest team drawn in the sweepstake draw (or a coin toss)
